en.bdb: Discussion with the siddhs and tour of Multan

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੇ ਕੀਤੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਿਧਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: baabe keetee sidh gosaT sabadh saa(n)t sidhaa(n) vich aaiee|

en.bdb: Baba has discussions with the siddhs and because of th eenergy of the sabad those siddhs attained peace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਣਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਾਤਿ ਦਾ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਆਦੇਸਿ ਕਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: jin melaa sivaraat dhaa khaT dharasan aadhes karaiee|

en.bdb: Conquering the Sivratri fair Baba made the followers of six philosophies bow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸੁਭਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡੀ ਕਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sidh bolan subh bachan dhan naanak teree vaddee kamaiee|

en.bdb: Now, speaking benign words, the siddhs said, Nanak, your achievement is great.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਗਟਿਆ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: vaddaa purakh paragaTiaa kalijug a(n)dhar jot jagaiee|

en.bdb: You, emerging like a  greatman in kaliyug have diffused the light (of knowledge) all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੇਲਿਓ ਬਾਬਾ ਉਠਿਆ ਮੁਲਤਾਨੇ ਦੀ ਜਾਰਤਿ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: melio baabaa uThiaa mulataane dhee jaarat jaiee|

en.bdb: Getting up from that fair, Baba went to the pilgrimage of Multan.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗੋਂ ਪੀਰ ਮੁਲਤਾਨ ਦੇ ਦੁਧਿ ਕਟੋਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: ago(n) peer mulataan dhe dhudh kaToraa bhar lai aaiee|

en.bdb: In Multan, the pir presented a bowl of milk filled up to brims (which means That faquirs here are already in plenty).

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੇ ਕਢਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਗਲ ਤੇ ਚੰਬੇਲੀ ਦੁਧਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: baabe kadd kar bagal te cha(n)belee dhudh vich milaiee|

en.bdb: Baba took out a jasmine flower from his bag and floated it on the milk (which meant that he wa not going to put anybody to trouble).
It was such a scene as if the Ganges were merging into the sea.
